      "step": 1,
      "text": "SCRAPE, WASH, PLACE {{ing_01|the fish}} IN A SAUCE PAN, ADD {{ing_02|OIL}}, {{ing_03|BROTH}}, {{ing_04|WINE}} AND {{ing_05|A BUNCH OF LEEKS}} AND {{ing_06|CORIANDER}} TO THE MESS."

    {

    {

    },
    {

    },

      "text": "ADD {{ing_10|RAISIN WINE}} TO TASTE, PUT IT INTO A POT AND ON THE FIRE TO HEAT."
    },

      "text": "TIE WITH {{ing_11|ROUX}} AND PRESENTLY ADD IT TO THE CONTENTS IN THE SAUCE PAN."
    },
    {
